title: Linear Equations & Systems
sub: 20 SPRs + 25 MCQs • Difficulty Progression • Official Digital SAT Curriculum

sections.heading: Part I — Student-Produced Response Questions (SPRs): Foundational Fluency (1–7)

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: If $2(x-6) = 3x-5$, what is the value of $x$?
questions.answer: **Answer:** $-7$. Distribute: $2x-12 = 3x-5$. $-x = -5 + 12 \Rightarrow x=-7$.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: $\begin{cases}x+6y=-43\\-x-y=13\end{cases}$ What is the value of $y$?
questions.answer: **Answer:** $-6$. Adding the equations eliminates $x$: $5y=-30 \Rightarrow y=-6$. Then $x=-7$.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: $\begin{cases}6x-3y=-6\\-6x+5y=-2\end{cases}$ What is the value of $y$?
questions.answer: **Answer:** $-4$. Adding the equations eliminates $x$: $2y=-8 \Rightarrow y=-4$. Then $x=-3$.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: If $3(x-2) = -3x-12$, what is the value of $x$?
questions.answer: **Answer:** $-1$. Distribute: $3x-6 = -3x-12$. $6x = -12 + 6 \Rightarrow x=-1$.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: If $2x+5 = -5x+47$, what is the value of $x$?
questions.answer: **Answer:** $6$. Applying Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations principles, $7x = 47 - 5 \Rightarrow x = 6$ Therefore, the verified correct option is 6.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: If $6(x+1) = -x+20$, what is the value of $x$?
questions.answer: **Answer:** $2$. Distribute: $6x+6 = -x+20$. $7x = 20 - 6 \Rightarrow x=2$.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: What is the sum of all solutions to $|3x - 9| = 15$?
questions.answer: **Answer:** $6$. Two cases: $3x - 9 = 15 \implies 3x = 24 \implies x = 8$; and $3x - 9 = -15 \implies 3x = -6 \implies x = -2$. The sum of solutions is $8 + (-2) = 6$.

sections.heading: Part I — Student-Produced Response Questions (SPRs): Intermediate Application (8–14)

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: If $2(x+7) = 3x+19$, what is the value of $x$?
questions.answer: **Answer:** $-5$. Distribute: $2x+14 = 3x+19$. $-x = 19 - 14 \Rightarrow x=-5$.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: If $2(x-5) = 4x-12$, what is the value of $x$?
questions.answer: **Answer:** $1$. Distribute: $2x-10 = 4x-12$. $-2x = -12 + 10 \Rightarrow x=1$.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: $\begin{cases}2x-2y=8\\-2x+3y=-7\end{cases}$ What is the value of $y$?
questions.answer: **Answer:** $1$. Adding the equations eliminates $x$: $y=1 \Rightarrow y=1$. Then $x=5$.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: If $2(x+1) = 3x-1$, what is the value of $x$?
questions.answer: **Answer:** $3$. Distribute: $2x+2 = 3x-1$. $-x = -1 - 2 \Rightarrow x=3$.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: If $8x-7 = -2x+73$, what is the value of $x$?
questions.answer: **Answer:** $8$. Applying Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations principles, $10x = 73 + 7 \Rightarrow x = 8$ Therefore, the verified correct option is 8.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: $\begin{cases}2x+6y=-48\\-2x+3y=-33\end{cases}$ What is the value of $x$?
questions.answer: **Answer:** $3$. Adding the equations eliminates $x$: $9y=-81 \Rightarrow y=-9$. Then $x=3$.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: $\begin{cases}5x-5y=-10\\-5x-4y=64\end{cases}$ What is the value of $x+y$?
questions.answer: **Answer:** $-14$. Adding the equations eliminates $x$: $-9y=54 \Rightarrow y=-6$. Then $x=-8$.

sections.heading: Part I — Student-Produced Response Questions (SPRs): Challenging Synthesis (15–20)

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: $\begin{cases}2x-5y=-9\\-2x-2y=16\end{cases}$ What is the value of $y$?
questions.answer: **Answer:** $-1$. Adding the equations eliminates $x$: $-7y=7 \Rightarrow y=-1$. Then $x=-7$.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: If $5x-10 = 4x-6$, what is the value of $x$?
questions.answer: **Answer:** $4$. Applying Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations principles, $x = -6 + 10 \Rightarrow x = 4$ Therefore, the verified correct option is 4.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: $\begin{cases}x+5y=-27\\-x-2y=9\end{cases}$ What is the value of $x+y$?
questions.answer: **Answer:** $-3$. Adding the equations eliminates $x$: $3y=-18 \implies y=-6$. Substituting gives $x=3$. Therefore, $x+y = 3 + (-6) = -3$.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: $\begin{cases}x-y=-1\\-x+3y=-1\end{cases}$ What is the value of $x$?
questions.answer: **Answer:** $-2$. Adding the equations eliminates $x$: $2y=-2 \Rightarrow y=-1$. Then $x=-2$.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: $\begin{cases}x-4y=-34\\-x+6y=50\end{cases}$ What is the value of $x+y$?
questions.answer: **Answer:** $6$. Adding the equations eliminates $x$: $2y=16 \Rightarrow y=8$. Then $x=-2$.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q:
Consider the system:
$\begin{cases} 3x + 2y = 19 \\ 2x - y = 8 \end{cases}$
What is the value of $x + y$?
questions.answer: **Answer:** $7$. From second equation, $y = 2x - 8$. Substitute into first: $3x + 2(2x - 8) = 19 \implies 7x - 16 = 19 \implies 7x = 35 \implies x = 5$. Then $y = 2(5) - 8 = 2$. So $x + y = 5 + 2 = 7$.

sections.heading: Part II — Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs): Foundational Fluency (21–28)

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: If $3x + 14 = 32$, what is the value of $x$?
questions.answer: Subtract 14 from both sides to get $3x = 18$, then divide by 3: $x = 6$.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: If $2(x - 8) = 8$, what is the value of $x$?
questions.answer: Divide both sides by 2: $x - 8 = 4$. Add 8: $x = 12$.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: A moving company charges a one-time fee of USD 30 plus USD 55 per mile. If the total charge was USD 305, how many miles was the move?
questions.answer: Let $n$ be the number of miles. Then $30 + 55n = 305$, so $55n = 275$ and $n = 5$.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: If $\frac{x}{3} + 5 = 13$, what is the value of $x$?
questions.answer: Subtract 5: $\frac{x}{3} = 8$. Multiply by 3: $x = 24$.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: If $8x + 12 = 4x + 36$, what is the value of $x$?
questions.answer: Subtract $4x$ and 12 from both sides: $4x = 24$, so $x = 6$.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: If $5x = 15$, what is the value of $10x$?
questions.answer: Multiply both sides of $5x = 15$ by 2: $10x = 30$.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: A taxi company charges a one-time fee of USD 25 plus USD 30 per mile. If the total charge was USD 175, how many miles was the trip?
questions.answer: Let $n$ be the number of miles. Then $25 + 30n = 175$, so $30n = 150$ and $n = 5$.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: If $\frac{x}{2} + 3 = 9$, what is the value of $x$?
questions.answer: Subtract 3: $\frac{x}{2} = 6$. Multiply by 2: $x = 12$.

sections.heading: Part II — Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs): Intermediate Application (29–37)

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: If $7x-8 = 8x-15$, what is the value of $x$?
questions.answer: Applying Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations principles, $-1x = -15 + 8 \Rightarrow x = 7$ Therefore, the verified correct option is 7.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: $\begin{cases}5x+y=-49\\-5x-4y=76\end{cases}$ What is the value of $x+y$?
questions.answer: Adding the equations eliminates $x$: $-3y=27 \Rightarrow y=-9$. Then $x=-8$.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: If $8x+1 = -x-26$, what is the value of $x$?
questions.answer: Applying Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations principles, $9x = -26 - 1 \Rightarrow x = -3$ Therefore, the verified correct option is -3.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: If $8x+2 = -4x-58$, what is the value of $x$?
questions.answer: $12x = -58 - 2 \Rightarrow x = -5$

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: If $7x-2 = -8x+28$, what is the value of $x$?
questions.answer: Applying Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations principles, $15x = 28 + 2 \Rightarrow x = 2$ Therefore, the verified correct option is 2.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: $\begin{cases}x+5y=24\\-x+2y=18\end{cases}$ What is the value of $x+y$?
questions.answer: Adding the equations eliminates $x$: $7y=42 \Rightarrow y=6$. Then $x=-6$.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: $\begin{cases}6x-6y=12\\-6x-2y=12\end{cases}$ What is the value of $x$?
questions.answer: Adding the equations eliminates $x$: $-8y=24 \Rightarrow y=-3$. Then $x=-1$.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: If $\frac{2}{x} + \frac{3}{2x} = \frac{7}{12}$, what is the value of $x$?
questions.answer: Common denominator is $2x$: $\frac{4 + 3}{2x} = \frac{7}{2x} = \frac{7}{12} \implies 2x = 12 \implies x = 6$.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: A coffee shop sells small coffees for USD $2.50$ and large coffees for USD $4.00$. On Monday, the shop sold 80 total coffees for USD $260$. How many large coffees were sold?
questions.answer: Let $s + l = 80$ and $2.5s + 4l = 260$. From first, $s = 80 - l$. Substitute: $2.5(80 - l) + 4l = 260 \implies 200 + 1.5l = 260 \implies 1.5l = 60 \implies l = 40$.

sections.heading: Part II — Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs): Challenging Synthesis (38–45)

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: $\begin{cases}4x+5y=13\\-x+6y=4\end{cases}$ What is the value of $x$?
questions.answer: Solving the system by elimination gives $x=2$ and $y=1$.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: $\begin{cases}4x+6y=4\\12x+ky=-15\end{cases}$ For what value of $k$ does this system of equations have no solution?
questions.answer: The lines are parallel (no solution) when the coefficients are proportional: $\frac{12}{4}=\frac{k}{6} \Rightarrow k=18$ (and the constants are not in that same ratio).

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: $\begin{cases}4x+2y=2\\8x+ky=-10\end{cases}$ For what value of $k$ does this system of equations have no solution?
questions.answer: The lines are parallel (no solution) when the coefficients are proportional: $\frac{8}{4}=\frac{k}{2} \Rightarrow k=4$ (and the constants are not in that same ratio).

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: $\begin{cases}6x+5y=4\\-2x-y=-4\end{cases}$ What is the value of $x$?
questions.answer: Solving the system by elimination gives $x=4$ and $y=-4$.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: What is the sum of all solutions to the equation $|2x+2| = 10$?

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: If $2x + 3y = 14$ and $5x + 4y = 28$, what is the value of $7x + 7y$?
questions.answer: Add the two equations directly: $(2x + 3y) + (5x + 4y) = 14 + 28 \implies 7x + 7y = 42$.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: For what value of $p$ does the equation $4(2x - 3) + p = 8x - 5$ have infinitely many solutions?
questions.answer: Expand left side: $8x - 12 + p = 8x - 5$. Subtract $8x$: $-12 + p = -5 \implies p = 7$.

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: A chemist needs to mix a 20% acid solution with a 50% acid solution to produce 60 liters of a 35% acid solution. How many liters of the 50% solution are required?
questions.answer: Let $x$ be liters of 20% solution and $y$ be liters of 50% solution. $x + y = 60$ and $0.20x + 0.50y = 0.35(60) = 21$. From first, $x = 60 - y$. Substitute: $0.20(60 - y) + 0.50y = 21 \implies 12 + 0.30y = 21 \implies 0.30y = 9 \implies y = 30$.
